## Cohen and Lin (2014), static GGA+U FeSiO3 Pv Vinet

**untested** (not refittable) · `fesio3_bridgmanite_cohen_lin_2014_vinet_1` · `Vinet` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/fesio3_bridgmanite.md#record-fesio3_bridgmanite_cohen_lin_2014_vinet_1)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** The eight energy-volume observations remain plot-only after source exhaustion. Table III independently prints V100=34.27 A3/FeSiO3, K100=597 GPa, and K100'=3.34; the stored curve is within 0.0108 A3/FeSiO3, 0.110 GPa, and 0.00114, respectively.
